about: Liquid densities of an open-access article, in the format of thermoml_<id>.json. The measured points are printed only in a figure (Figure 7); the article gives, in Table 4, the liquid density at 120 degC (1.3446 g/cm3) and the liquid volumetric expansion coefficient alpha_V = 5.02e-04 1/K from the melting temperature to 150 degC, from a linear fit that the authors state is within 0.3 % of the measured points (section 3.2). The values here are that linear fit, rho(T) = rho(120 degC) [1 - alpha_V (T - 393.15 K)], at the listed temperatures, not read off the figure. Eq. (2) defines alpha_V with the density at the first measured liquid temperature, which is not printed; taking rho(120 degC) for it changes the slope by under alpha_V x 30 K (1.5 % of the slope), under 0.03 % of the density over the range. Range: 90 degC (the DSC melting temperature of Table 4) to 150 degC. Uncertainty: 0.3 %, the authors' largest deviation of the fit from the points (the measurement uncertainty is below 0.1 %, k = 1). Technical-grade samples.
